openai.feedback:
- Category: bug
- Severity: medium
- File: client/src/hooks/useMissionAgents.ts:56–60
- Finding: Agent updates depend on changes to top-level chat subrunner cards. When a nested reviewer starts or finishes inside a running parent agent, those cards can remain unchanged, so session-info is never refreshed. The chip can show the wrong running count, and the window can omit children or retain completed children under Active until a manual refresh or focus event.
- Suggestion: Refresh session-info while agents are running, or subscribe to events covering nested subagent changes. Add a test where a child starts and completes without changing the top-level card signature.

Overall assessment: ship-with-fixes. The main UI and transcript route cover the requested functionality, but nested agent activity needs a reliable update mechanism.

SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: revise

glm.feedback:
## Findings

- Category: edge-case
  Severity: medium
  File: client/src/hooks/useMissionAgents.ts:47-54 (signature effect)
  Finding: The running-count in the bar only refreshes on mount/focus/manual refresh or when the *feed card signature* changes. The signature is derived from `ActivityCard`s of kind `subrunner`. In a campaign session (spec explicitly requires it to work there) or any path where an agent dispatch/completion does not surface as a subrunner card in this feed, the chip's "<n> agents running" count can go stale — e.g. stay at "2 agents running" after both agents finish, or never appear for agents dispatched outside the card stream.
  Suggestion: Also key the rescan on something agent-derived (e.g. transcript poll tick already available in MissionBody), or refetch on a lightweight interval while the Mission tab is visible.

- Category: bug
  Severity: low
  File: client/src/components/external/mission/AgentsWindow.tsx:23-27 (onCloseAutoFocus)
  Finding: `controller.returnFocusRef.current?.focus()` — if the window was opened programmatically while `document.activeElement` was `body` (or the originating element was unmounted, e.g. a feed card removed after a refresh), focus silently drops to `body`, breaking keyboard nav and the e2e expectation of chip focus in those flows.
  Suggestion: Fall back to focusing the chip (or the Dialog close button) when `returnFocusRef.current` is null or no longer in the document.

- Category: edge-case
  Severity: low
  File: client/src/components/external/mission/AgentsWindow.tsx:24-26 (selected fallback)
  Finding: When the selected agent disappears after a refresh (agent ids can change between scans if M2 rebuilds them), `selected` silently falls back to the first agent while `selectedId` state stays stale; the list then shows no row as selected (`selectedId={selected?.agentId}` papers over it, but the stale id is never cleared).
  Suggestion: Clear/reset `selectedId` when it no longer resolves to an agent, rather than only masking it at render.

- Category: test
  Severity: low
  File: client/src/components/external/mission/AgentsDock.test.tsx:81-84
  Finding: The transcript-tab test fires both `mouseDown` and `click` on the tab trigger — the `mouseDown` is redundant and suggests it was added to work around focus/timing flakiness rather than validating real behavior; a broken tab implementation that renders both panes unconditionally would still pass the "agent says hi" assertion.
  Suggestion: Drop the redundant `mouseDown` and assert the Details pane is hidden/not present while the Transcript tab is active.

- Category: edge-case
  Severity: low
  File: server/src/core/session-info/subagent-transcript.ts:29-36 (readWindow shrink race)
  Finding: If the file shrinks between `stat` and `read` (e.g. truncated/rotated), `bytesRead === 0` breaks with `off === 0`; the caller then computes `w.start > 0` from the stale start and `bytes.indexOf(10) + 1` on an empty buffer, returning `truncated: true` with empty content. Harmless but produces a misleading "truncated" flag for an empty read.
  Suggestion: Treat `off === 0 && bytesRead === 0` as a missing/empty result rather than a truncated one.

## Notes (verified clean)

- Path traversal in the transcript route is well handled: id grammar check, realpath equality via `path.relative` (not startsWith), single open with handle-level regular-file check. The e2e and route tests cover the traversal, symlink-escape, and directory-named-like-file cases with real files.
- `forest()`'s cycle guard (`seen`) is correct, including the second pass that re-lists cycle-only members as roots.
- The killed/stopped handling in `resolveSubrunnerNotification` correctly maps to `failed` with an end-status marker, and the later-completed overwrite is tested.
- MissionBody's `openFor(id) || handleNodeClick(...)` preserves the legacy SubrunnerPanel fallback, so existing callers aren't broken; the old tests are updated with a hook mock rather than removed.

## Overall assessment

Ship-with-fixes — the core implementation is solid and well-tested; the findings are refinements (stale running-count in campaign sessions being the most user-visible one) rather than blockers.

SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: approve
